0022600093.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Clippers hosting the Sacramento Kings. The Clippers have Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) out, while Kobe Sanders (hip) and Kris Dunn (rest) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. For Sacramento, Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee) are out, and Malik Monk (ankle soreness) is day-to-day and a game-time decision; the Clippers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 138-109 win in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Clippers a 65% chance to win.
